title: IEA’s World Energy Outlook 2026 looks at nuclear power’s future amid global turmoil
html:
The global crises currently impacting energy supply and demand have countries looking inward to solve their energy needs. A shift toward more domestic energy resources ultimately should help nuclear energy, the International Energy Agency argued in its latest annual World Energy Outlook.

The energy market impacts of the conflicts in the Middle East and the resulting disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz echo the oil crises of the 1970s. According to the World Energy Outlook 2026, issued on November 19, the current global moment should reinforce the resurgence of nuclear power.
summary: The IEA argues in its World Energy Outlook 2026 that a shift toward domestic energy resources amid global crises should ultimately help nuclear power.
